judgments.en_span: Pursuant to the Agreement, the Company has conditionally agreed to acquire the Sale Shares, being 6,000 ordinary shares in the Target, representing 60% of the entire issued share capital of the Target as at the date of this announcement.
judgments.zh_span: 根據本協議，本公司有條件同意收購銷售股份，即目標公司6,000股普通股，相當於目標公司於本公告日期全部已發行股本的60%。
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey the same conditional agreement to acquire 60% of the Target's issued share capital through 6,000 ordinary shares.

judgments.en_span: The remaining 40% of the issued share capital of the Target is held by Mr. Lam Tak Shing, an Independent Third Party, who will continue to hold his interest following Completion.
judgments.zh_span: 目標公司餘下40%的已發行股本由獨立第三方林德成先生持有，彼於完成後將繼續持有其權益。
judgments.explanation: Both passages state that the remaining 40% is held by an Independent Third Party who will continue holding after Completion.

judgments.en_span: The Sale Shares shall be acquired free from all encumbrances and together with all rights attaching to them as at Completion, including the right to receive all dividends declared, made or paid on or after the date of Completion.
judgments.zh_span: 銷售股份將於完成時在不附帶任何產權負擔的情況下連同所附帶的一切權利予以收購，包括收取於完成日期或之後宣派、作出或支付的所有股息的權利。
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey that Sale Shares are acquired free of encumbrances with all rights including dividend rights from Completion date onwards.
